RHI.headline: McKinsey’s Newest Analysts Are AI Agents
RHI.description: AI agents are replacing junior analysts in professional services firms, threatening the traditional billable-hour business model. Companies that own essential databases, software systems, or can charge for outcomes rather than hours are best positioned to thrive in this transition. McKinsey now employs 20,000 AI agents alongside 40,000 humans, signaling the scale of this shift.
